BiblicalUsage: Sheresh is the son of Machir, named in the genealogy of Manasseh. He is the brother of Peresh, and his name stands in the line that settles east of the Jordan.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a brother's name in Manasseh's genealogy is a place in the tribe that settled east of the Jordan.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
